outcome: Nucleated red blood cells (NRBCs) per white blood cell (WBC) count in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 305 normal term neonates, divided into a normal vaginal delivery group (case, 155 neonates) and a cesarean section group (control, 150 neonates).
finding: There was no significant difference in the mean NRBC count per 100 WBCs in umbilical cord blood between neonates born by normal vaginal delivery and those delivered by cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in the mean NRBC count within the umbilical cord of neonates based on their mode of birth (normal vaginal delivery vs. elective cesarean section).
